title: SvgFeTile
responsibility: Renders the native feTile element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgFeTile.attributes
inputs.description: Native feTile attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgFeTile.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native feTile element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgFeTile
outputs.description: The actual native feTile element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
